title: PSG-19 Imported STL Plaster-over-Concrete Surface Regions
visual_intent: A fresh purpose-built statue fragment is imported from STL. Warm aged plaster remains the base; a continuous authored region reveals darker pitted concrete through irregular, feathered patches without changing topology or silhouette.
expected_visual_signal: The layered beauty must show readable concrete exposure islands with smooth cross-layer borders, while the raw mask and provenance views explain exactly where the blend came from.
rejection_condition: Reject if the object is a reused preset, the coating boundary is binary, repeat pixels differ, source topology changes, or the beauty result cannot be associated with the raw region field.
